title: Cost
description: Arkham.Cost.Cost, derived with Aeson's default sum encoding (backend/arkham-api/library/Arkham/Cost.hs: 'deriveToJSON defaultOptions ''Cost'). Because Cost has constructors with arguments, 'allNullaryToStringTag' does not apply: every constructor -- including nullary ones like 'Free' -- encodes as a TaggedObject ('{"tag": ...}', with a 'contents' key added for constructors that carry data). Verified against the real encoder: 'Free' encodes as {"tag":"Free"}, never a bare string. This asserts the closed top-level TaggedObject envelope (only 'tag' plus optional 'contents' are permitted; unknown keys fail closed) while deliberately leaving 'contents' unconstrained, since this is a broad tagged union (dozens of constructors covering action/resource/clue/discard/matcher-driven costs) and its per-constructor payload shape stays intentionally out of scope for this contract slice -- do not narrow 'contents' further without dedicated fixture evidence for a specific constructor.

contents.description: Present only for non-nullary Cost constructors; its shape varies per constructor and stays intentionally out of scope for this contract slice.
